title: Kinhold Update: A look at the different enemy settlements and the games biomes
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Kinhold is being made with Claude Code. This clip goes into some of the different enemy settlements, and it goes through the building/wall tiers. Higher tiers provide better defense - and a better quality village score, for the players village. The higher the village score, the happier your villagers, and the higher their fertility rate. You can see the initial look of the biomes here as well. For enemy settlements, as time goes on they have better walls and gear, and the loot reward for defeating them gets better. But this is only for ones you havent found yet - once you find one, they are locked to the rate you found them at. All of this is still in development, as well.
